references: General herb sources: Wikipedia; Mount Sinai/UMM herb DB; EMA HMPC monographs; ageless.co.za

uses: Centuries of Scandinavian, Eastern European and British use of the fruit for vision and antioxidant support; taken as jam, tea and tincture.
cautions: Fruit very safe; leaf only short-term; blood-sugar caution.
